name: mcp_auto_loader_rfdiffusion2
description: Run RFdiffusion2 protein backbone design using MCP protocol

RFDIFFUSION2_MCP_SERVER_HOST.purpose: Host of a self-hosted RFdiffusion2 protein-design MCP server.
RFDIFFUSION2_MCP_SERVER_HOST.without: Leave blank unless you run your own RFdiffusion2 server.

return_schema.description: What run() hands back. It branches on `operation` and has exactly three success shapes -- see MCPAutoLoaderTool.run in mcp_client_tool.py. There is no error branch: _run_with_cleanup has no except clause, so a failure leaves run() as an exception and the dispatch layer, not this schema, is what turns it into a value. The three branches share no required key, so exactly one of them matches any real return.

oneOf.description: operation="discover": everything the server's tools/list reported. All three keys are set unconditionally, so all three are required. Note that discovery does not honour `selected_tools` -- that filter applies only to generate_configs -- so this lists the whole server.

discovered_count.description: len(tool_details). Zero when the server offers nothing.

tools.description: The names only, in the order the server listed them.

tool_details.description: Each name mapped to its full descriptor.

oneOf.description: operation="generate_configs": the discovered tools rendered as MCPProxyTool configurations, after `selected_tools` filtering. Both keys are set unconditionally and count == len(configs). Discovery runs first if it has not already.

operation="call_tool": what the RFdiffusion2 server answered, passed through untouched -- mcp.types.CallToolResult rendered by model_dump(mode="json"). `isError` true means the server reported a tool-level failure; the call itself still succeeded, which is why that case arrives here and not as an exception. Only `content` is required: the SDK makes it the one mandatory field, and although model_dump emits `isError` for every http call, the websocket branch of _make_mcp_request hands back the raw JSON-RPC result, where it may be absent.

content.description: Content blocks; each carries its own `type`.

mcp_tool.description: One mcp.types.Tool, as model_dump(mode="json") renders it. `name` and `inputSchema` are the SDK's only required fields; the rest are emitted with a null default. Not closed to further keys: the project pins mcp>=1.29.0,<2.0.0, so a minor release may add some.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's arguments.

proxy_config.description: One MCPProxyTool configuration, as generate_proxy_tool_configs builds it (mcp_client_tool.py line 1082). The first eight keys are set unconditionally; every other key is set only when the loader's own config asked for it, or when the server's descriptor carried it.

parameter.description: The server's inputSchema for this tool, or {"type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": []} when it published none.

return_schema.description: Present only when the server published an outputSchema.

mcp_contract_sha256.description: Present only when the loader sets strict_tool_contracts.

operation.description: Which of run()'s three branches to take: list the tools this RFdiffusion2 server offers, turn that list into MCPProxyTool configurations, or call one of those tools. Required: run() raises ValueError('Unsupported operation: None') when it is left out.

tool_name.description: Name of the server-side tool to call, as `discover` reports it. Required when operation is call_tool -- run() raises ValueError without it -- and ignored otherwise.

tool_arguments.description: Arguments for that tool, matching the inputSchema `discover` returned for it. Defaults to {} and is ignored unless operation is call_tool.
